import logging

def parse_switch(text):
    """Parse trimmed case-insensitive on/yes/enabled/1 as True and off/no/disabled/0 as False; reject all other values."""
    logger.info("ce002_fixture_called function=parse_switch")
    value = text.strip().casefold()
    if value in ("on", "yes", "enabled", "1"):
        return True
    if value in ("off", "no", "disabled", "0"):
        return False
    raise ValueError("unknown switch")

def bytes_ceiling(count, unit):
    """Return ceiling count divided by unit for nonnegative count and positive unit; invalid bounds raise ValueError."""
    logger.info("ce002_fixture_called function=bytes_ceiling")
